title: U.S. bond intervention is like 'paying your mortgage with your credit card,' JPMorgan's Sullivan says
summary_full: The U.S. government's efforts to manage pressure in the Treasury market risk merely shifting the problem down the road, according to JPMorgan's James Sullivan.
summary_public: The U.S. government's efforts to manage pressure in the Treasury market risk merely shifting the problem down the road, according to JPMorgan's James Sullivan.
